name: deenhistory
description: DeenHistory is an open source Islamic history web and mobile app featuring the Holy Quran (with Uthmani script and audio recitation), stories of the 25 Prophets, Seerah milestones, authentic duas, and records of empires and decisive battles.

paragraphs: DeenHistory is a comprehensive, interactive Islamic history and divine scripture web application built to make learning Islamic history, Seerah, and the Holy Quran accessible, structured, and engaging.
features: The Holy Quran: Read with Uthmani script, English translation, and listen to verse-by-verse audio recitations (by Mishary Rashid Alafasy) with full Surah queue playback.
Prophets & Seerah: Detailed chronological logs of the 25 Prophets mentioned in the Quran alongside milestone epochs of Prophet Muhammad's (ﷺ) life.
Companions & Eras: Comprehensive records of the Sahabah, major historical battles, and golden-age Islamic caliphates.
Signposts & Lessons: Explore prophetical accounts of major signs of Judgment Day and lessons from historical civilizations.
Android & Web Ready: Available as a responsive web app and downloadable Android APK.

whatItDoes.text: DeenHistory is a comprehensive, interactive Islamic history and divine scripture web application built to make learning Islamic history, Seerah, and the Holy Quran accessible, structured, and engaging.
